title: Radiology Technologist Multi-Modality
description:
Job Summary:

Operates diagnostic radiologic equipment to produce radiographic images of the body. Operates one or more specialized radiographic equipment such as Screening Mammography, Computerized Tomography, and/or Magnetic Resonance Imaging for diagnostic purposes.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Position patient and adjust immobilization devices to obtain optimum views of specified area of body requested by physician.
  • Explain procedures to allow for understanding, cooperation and to reduce anxiety of patient.
  • Administer appropriate pharmaceuticals pursuant to procedure, place IVs and administer enemas as required.
  • Practice radiation protection techniques by using beam restrictive devices, patient shielding skills, and applicable exposure factors to minimize radiation to the patient, staff, and others as necessary.
  • Move radiographic equipment into specified position and adjust equipment controls to set graphic exposure factors, such as time and distance, based on knowledge of radiographic exposure techniques and protocols.
  • Obtain acceptable radiographic images using appropriate Computerized Radiology and/or CR/DR techniques and protocols.
  • Acquire and disseminate patient information data for exam order using Hospital EMR System.
  • Write information in patient charts as required or necessary.
  • Perform quality control checks to ensure proper operating status.
  • Report malfunctions pursuant to established protocols.
  • Maintain examination rooms and stock necessary medical and radiologic supplies pursuant to established protocols.
  • Exercise independent judgment in planning sequence of operations and making minor decisions in a complex technical or professional field.
  • Interact directly with patients and/or customers, as well as internal customers via telephone or face-to-face interaction.
  • Collaborate with other healthcare professionals and staff.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Six (6) months to one (1) year of related experience.
  • Working knowledge of radiographic exposure techniques and protocols, CR/Film screen exposure techniques and protocols, Computerized Tomography, Mammography, and/or Magnetic Resonance Imaging technical principles and procedures.
  • Knowledge of anatomy and physiology.
  • Ability to properly administer pharmaceuticals intravenously for imaging procedures.
  • Knowledge of sharps usage practices and techniques.
  • Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to integrate the analysis of data to Client facts or develop knowledge, concepts or interpretations.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work in an effective and efficient manner.
  • Attention to detail as required in the examination of clinical and numerical data.

Required Education:

  • Completion of an accredited Radiologic Technology Program.

Required Certification & Licensure:

  • Registration from the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT).
  • Current CPR Certification.

title: Functional Safety Engineer
description:
Possible 3 Month CTH

Role: Functional Safety Engineer
Work location: Remote
Background and Meet and Greet: MANDATORY

Job Description:
"We are seeking an entry-level Functional Safety Engineer to ensure the safety and reliability of our autonomous robotic vehicles. The role involves identification of hazards and risks using Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA), supporting definition of requirements, and implementing measures throughout the product development lifecycle. The Functional Safety Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate safety into the design, development, verification, and validation of our technologies, adhering to industry standards and regulations.

ESSENTIAL EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE, JOB SKILLS
Education:
• Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related field.
• Relevant certifications such as Certified Functional Safety Expert (CFSE), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), Automotive Functional Safety Professional (AFSP), Functional Safety Engineer or similar credentials are highly preferred
Experience:
• 0-3 years of experience in functional safety engineering, preferably in industries such as robotics, automotive, earth-moving or mining machinery, or agricultural equipment.
• Specific experience with functional safety using STPA.
Skills:
• Proficient understanding of functional safety standards.
• Basic skills in identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with functional safety like STPA, FMEA, and FTA.
• Knowledge of safety lifecycle processes and safety integrity levels.
• Proficient analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex safety and compliance issues.
• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and documentation skills to maintain safety records and compliance reports.
• Analytical skills to evaluate safety data, conduct risk assessments, and identify areas for improvement.
• Proven leadership skills, including the ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.
• Ability to present and summarize reports and analysis for leadership, customer, and regulatory authority reviews.

Key Responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Promote a culture of safety and compliance throughout the organization by fostering an environment where safety is prioritized and integrated into daily operations.
• Contribute to the development of functional safety concepts and requirements for autonomous vehicle control systems.
• Good understanding of Functional Safety lifecycles in general.
• Conduct safety analysis, including STPA, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA).
• Collaborate with hardware and software engineering teams to ensure safety requirements are allocated to the design and development process.
• Review safety verification and validation activities, including safety testing and simulation.
• Ensure compliance with internal safety processes and workflows, which are loosely based on a mixture of relevant safety standards (e.g., ISO 25119, ISO 13849, IEC 61508) and regulatory requirements.
• Prepare and maintain safety documentation, including safety plans, safety cases, and safety reports.
• Participate in safety audits and assessments, both internal and external.
• Contribute to technical guidance and support to project teams on functional safety matters.
• Stay updated with the latest advancements in functional safety and autonomous vehicle technologies. "

• Relevant certifications such as Certified Functional Safety Expert (CFSE), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), Automotive Functional Safety Professional (AFSP), Functional Safety Engineer or similar credentials are highly preferred
Experience:

• Specific experience with functional safety using STPA.
Skills:

title: Scientist I
description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Scientist 1 to join our Formulation team. In this hands-on laboratory role, you will work closely with senior scientists to execute and optimize the synthesis of targeted and non-targeted lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for nucleic acid delivery. The successful candidate will be a collaborative team player with strong technical and data analysis skills who is ready to contribute to our non-viral delivery platform.
Responsibilities:
Execute and optimize the synthesis and characterization of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) encapsulating nucleic acids for in vitro and in vivo studies under the guidance of senior formulation scientists.
Implement Design of Experiment (DoE) based screening campaigns to evaluate and establish optimal LNP compositions and processing parameters.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to support and fulfill formulation requests.
Support early-stage formulation development and downstream processing activities, including cryoprotection, scale-up, and stability studies.
Maintain detailed records documenting formulation activities and results.
Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data to the formulation team.
Contribute to routine lab management activities, including inventory tracking, supply ordering, buffer preparation, and autoclaving.
Requirements, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline with 2+ years of biopharma industry experience, OR a Master’s degree with 1+ years of industry experience.
LNP Expertise: Minimum of 1–2 years of hands-on laboratory experience specializing in LNP formulation and encapsulation of nucleic acids (mRNA, siRNA, or DNA).
Analytical Skills: Proficiency with standard LNP characterization methods, including Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS), Zeta potential, and Ribogreen assays.
Preferred Skills: Prior experience with Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF), dialysis, and bioconjugation chemistry is highly desirable.
Software & Data: High proficiency in MS Excel is required; hands-on experience with statistical and data analysis software (e.g., JMP, Prism) is preferred.
Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, a track record of producing reproducible data, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to communicate effectively within a fast-paced team environment.

title: R&D Engineer III
description:
Description:

About the role:
Client* is seeking a highly motivated R&D Engineer to join the Carlsbad Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) Sustaining R&D team.

The IVL Sustaining Engineering R&D group provides design ownership and technical support for commercialized IVL products, ensuring patient safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing continuity, and lifecycle value.

Job Purpose

Responsible for sustaining commercial IVL devices throughout the product lifecycle, including design changes, supplier and material changes, manufacturing support, quality investigations, shelf-life and labeling updates, and technical assessments needed to maintain product performance, regulatory compliance, patient safety, and supply continuity.

With limited supervision, the role involves compiling, analyzing, and reporting design, manufacturing, quality, complaint, testing, and research data to ensure design intent is maintained after launch. The candidate will serve as a key technical resource for cross-functional sustaining projects and provide product and clinical-use expertise.

Key Responsibilities
•Use of the design change process to ensure proposed changes are systematically and thoroughly analyzed before beginning the change process. Whenever product changes are proposed, justification is written, or data is collected to verify that the design intent is still met.
•Works cross-functionally with project management, quality, manufacturing, regulatory, clinical,l and marketing to ensure project success.
•Work collaboratively with manufacturing to reduce product costs through design improvements.
•Works with other functions to understand feedback from the market, providing design knowledge input to understand device performance and anatomy interaction, look for opportunities for device improvement, and interact with physicians as necessary to optimize outcomes.
•Interfaces with vendors and physicians where projects require.
•Maintain product performance through Quality Investigations and ensure rigorous support for design changes.
•Works independently to plan and schedule own activities necessary to meet timelines.
•Performs troubleshooting on products/process problems as related to design, material, or process.
•Summarizes, analyzes,s and draws conclusions from test results, prepares standard reports/documentation to communicate results to the technical community.
•Must be able to provide technical guidance within a team and be an effective communicator within a multidisciplinary and international organization.
•Leads or participates in a cross-functional team to perform troubleshooting on products/process problems as related to design, material, or process.
•Demonstrates a primary commitment to patient safety and product quality.

Qualifications
•Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science/Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience; or Ph.D. with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
•Minimum of 5 years of experience in the medical device industry preferred, with direct experience in catheter-based disposables, intravascular devices, or other Class II/III sterile single-use devices strongly preferred.
•Demonstrated experience with design controls, change control, risk management, design verification/validation, test method development, root cause analysis, and technical documentation in an FDA-regulated medical device environment.
•Strong technical knowledge of catheter design, polymeric materials, extrusions, bonding technologies, adhesives, coatings, laser welding, sterilization, packaging, and/or high-volume disposable device manufacturing preferred.
•Proven ability to lead technical problem solving in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, manage multiple sustaining projects simultaneously, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and maintain a primary commitment to patient safety and product quality.

title: Consumer Loan Servicing Specialist: II
description:
Position Summary

  • The Note Finance Collateral & Documentation Analyst is responsible for the review, validation, tracking, and custody of loan collateral documentation supporting borrowing base lending facilities. This role performs detailed reviews of legal and collateral documents to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with internal requirements prior to funding and throughout the lifecycle of the loan.
  • The analyst serves as a key control point by validating collateral information against borrowing base reports, loan systems, and supporting source documentation. The position requires strong attention to detail, document management experience, and the ability to identify and escalate exceptions that may impact collateral perfection, lending compliance, or portfolio risk.
  • This is a contract position supporting the Note Finance Operations team.

 

Primary Responsibilities

 

Collateral Management

  • Receive, organize, and maintain collateral packages for newly funded and existing loans.
  • Check in and track physical and electronic collateral documents.
  • Maintain collateral inventory logs and tracking tools.
  • Ensure collateral files are complete and properly indexed.
  • Support collateral transfers, releases, and audits.

 

Document Review & Validation

  • Review and validate documentation including:
    • Promissory Notes
    • Titles
    • Assignments
    • Deeds
    • Deeds of Trust
    • Security Agreements
    • Collateral Schedules
    • Additional supporting legal documents

 

Borrowing Base Verification

  • Review collateral documentation against Borrowing Base reports.
  • Verify collateral values, counts, and asset information.
  • Confirm pledged collateral is accurately reflected in the Borrowing Base.
  • Research and resolve discrepancies between source documents and system records.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inaccurate collateral records.

 

Quality Control & Exception Management

  • Perform quality assurance reviews of collateral files.
  • Identify document defects, missing signatures, recording issues, expired documents, and collateral exceptions.
  • Document findings and maintain exception logs.
  • Escalate high-risk collateral deficiencies to management.
  • Assist with remediation of collateral and documentation exceptions.

 

Operational & Administrative Support

  • Update internal systems with collateral and document status.
  • Maintain accurate records supporting audits and examinations.
  • Assist with portfolio reviews and collateral certifications.
  • Support internal and external audit requests.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and control effectiveness.

 

Required Qualifications

 

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field preferred.

 

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Commercial Lending Operations
    • Mortgage Operations
    • Loan Documentation
    • Collateral Review
    • Title Review
    • Loan Servicing
    • Banking Operations

 

Skills

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Experience reviewing legal and loan documentation.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and data quality issues.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with borrowing base lending.
  • Experience reviewing titles and assignments.
  • Experience with collateral custody or vault management.
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance reviews, or regulatory examinations.
  • Financial institution or specialty lending experience strongly preferred.

 

Success Measures

  • The successful candidate will consistently:
  • Maintain accurate collateral records.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies before they become customer or audit issues.
  • Ensure borrowing base collateral matches supporting documentation.
  • Reduce collateral exceptions and outstanding defects.
  • Support audit-ready documentation and operational controls.
  • Process collateral reviews within established service level expectations.

title: Help Desk Support II
description:
Job Title: Help Desk Support II
Job Location: Denver, Colorado, 80246 (Remote)
Job Duration: 12 months

Job Summary:
  • Looking for an IT Support Specialist to provide technical support to both the BITS Technology team & the Child Care Automated Tracking System (CHATS) team by assisting with internal and external end-user technical support, incident management, end-user issue testing, and validation activities, and maintaining technical documentation.
  • This position will also be responsible for maintaining Issue tracking systems, including but not limited to Salesforce Helpdesk and Jira.
  • Responsibilities include: managing the support emails and calls from internal and external system users; updating Issue tracking systems with information from service desk reports; creating and/or providing reports to groups interested in this information; and, assigning incident work items to team members as needed.
Job Description:
  • Provides Salesforce and Salesforce third-party application support to to internal and external users on CHATS technology issues and identifies, researches, and resolves technical problems.
  • Follows up with internal and external users, by email, phone, or webinar to gather more information to identify and solve technical problems related to the CHATS Salesforce application.
  • Documents, tracks, and monitors technical issues to ensure a timely resolution.
  • Submits and tracks user-reported issues in the incident management system(s)
  • Ensure the incident is assigned the correct priority, category, and impact
  • Validates user-reported bugs and system issues and identifies the root cause
  • Identify when issues are beyond the scope of basic support/Tier 1 and escalate and assign the incident to the appropriate internal or external technical team resource to be worked on and tracked to ensure the work is completed.
  • Ensures that the issues reported are documented with steps to reproduce expected outcomes, and include enough detail to easily reproduce, validate, and report to the administrator or developer to reach a resolution.
  • Communicates with end users to inform them of known system issues and issue resolution
  • Identifies issues/bugs that are duplicates of existing issues and creates a relationship with the parent ticket.
  • Assists with maintaining status on work items as things move through the bug/issue life cycle.
  • Documents issues and issue resolution to be used to update programmatic Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) and user guides.
  • Updates internal and external users on the status of their incident/bug requests.
  • Adhere to and inform the standard process for issue identification and resolution
  • Communicates to end users changes in the system, points of clarification, overall technical assistance, and updates to current processes based on issues reported and issues resolved
  • Participates in testing and validation activities.
Qualifications:
  • Three years (minimum) demonstrated knowledge of and experience using: Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Suite
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Accurate, thorough, and detail-oriented
  • Efficient with time-sensitive projects
  • Preferred: Three years experience with using Salesforce Customer Resource Management (CRM) and Jira
  • Preferred: Functional understanding of the CHATS application
  • Preferred: Current Salesforce Administrator Certification in progress
